evidence.detail: GET /llms.txt → HTTP 404; GET /llms-full.txt → HTTP 404; homepage has no llms.txt link
semantic landmarks 0/4; no h1; missing html[lang]; body text 1 words (too low)
GET /sitemap.xml → HTTP 404; robots.txt unavailable or non-2xx; cannot check Sitemap reference
title "Redirection..."; missing/too-short meta description; no date signal; body text 1 words (low)

no in-site chat/assistant; no AI search; no developer console
